title: Hampshire Young Labour Campaign Day (Fareham/Gosport)

Fareham is a crucial battleground, with much of the council sitting within the Fareham constituency. Reform are pushing hard here, and we've got a real opportunity to challenge them and win these seats, but only if we're out speaking to voters. Even if you've never canvassed before, come out and meet young members from across Hampshire!

Whether you’ve been involved before or you’re thinking about stepping in for the first time, there’s a place for you. You can help by: 🔴 Talking with residents 🔴 Delivering information and materials 🔴 Supporting the team behind the scenes 🔴 Helping share our message online This is about teamwork, visibility, and showing the strength of our community. Momentum matters, and staying active on the ground is how we make sure people have the facts they need. If you’re able to join any of the upcoming sessions, let us know below — every person who gets involved helps move us forward.

title: Local Elections Thurrock
location: Dickens Ave, Tilbury RM18 8HJ, UK
meeting_point: Corner of Dickens Avenue & Thackeray Avenue RM18 8HJ
description: Let’s Make Every Conversation Count We’re entering the final stretch, and the work we do from now until 7th May will shape the future of our community. Every weekend from here on, we’ll be out speaking with residents, knocking on doors, sharing information, and making sure every voice is heard. This is a defining moment. Polls don’t decide outcomes — people do. And the effort we put in together will make all the difference. Whether you’ve been involved before or you’re thinking about stepping in for the first time, there’s a place for you. You can help by: 🔴 Talking with residents 🔴 Delivering information and materials 🔴 Supporting the team behind the scenes 🔴 Helping share our message online This is about teamwork, visibility, and showing the strength of our community. Momentum matters, and staying active on the ground is how we make sure people have the facts they need. If you’re able to join any of the upcoming sessions, let us know below — every person who gets involved helps move us forward.

Polls don’t decide outcomes — people do. And the effort we put in together will make all the difference. Whether you’ve been involved before or you’re thinking about stepping in for the first time, there’s a place for you. You can help by: 🔴 Talking with residents 🔴 Delivering information and materials 🔴 Supporting the team behind the scenes 🔴 Helping share our message online This is about teamwork, visibility, and showing the strength of our community. Momentum matters, and staying active on the ground is how we make sure people have the facts they need. If you’re able to join any of the upcoming sessions, let us know below — every person who gets involved helps move us forward.

title: Argyll and Bute: The Healthcare Afterthought
description: Dr Callum George, Scottish Labour candidate for Argyll and Bute and local resident doctor, has today announced an emergency online roundtable event to address the worsening crisis in rural and island healthcare. The event, titled Argyll and Bute: The Healthcare Afterthought will take place on the evening of Wednesday 29th April at 6:30pm. It aims to bring together patients, clinicians, and advocacy groups to discuss the systemic neglect of women's health, child health, sexual health, and the controversial removal of chronic pain services across the region and beyond. The summit follows recent revelations concerning the Scottish Government attempts to bypass clinical expertise in pain management and the continued hollowing out of maternity and specialist services in Argyll and Bute, services overseen by the local MSP and Minister for Public Health and Women's Health, Jenni Minto. The event will be hosted via a digital platform to ensure residents from across both the islands and mainland can participate. The meeting can be joined via this link: https://tinyurl.com/argyllhealthcare and will begin at 6:30pm on Wednesday 29th April 2026, lasting approximately 1.5 hours, depending on the conversation.
